scope: 82DF6240 complete 325-instruction CRT open caller composed with five accepted position bodies and five accepted open bodies (885 complete original PPC instructions in validation pin). Four focused paths: invalid flags, record slot allocation failure, native open failure, binary success. All selected 32 GPR/FPR, CR0/6, XER, LR/CTR, FP cache, ordered RAM and callbacks compared; deeper mutable guest/native/fault/MMIO paths remain explicit.
